snippet.title: Voidling Bound | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2004680/Voidling_Bound/

Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

Become a Space Wrangler and take direct control of creatures called "Voidlings", shape them through branching evolution paths and upgrade their abilities to overcome bubonic swarms, pestilent bosses, and reclaim lush planets overrun by corruption.
